summary: Feature verification for (1) Library 'Toutes' tab with filter chips and (2) Premium 7-day free trial CTA. ALL 6 test cases from the review request PASS. Vanilla HTML/JS app tested via Playwright at /api/app in guest mode. #lt-all tab exists and is active by default showing 474 recipes ('474 recettes'). All 5 filter chips (filter-carb5/carb10/time15/facile/vegan) exist and correctly filter cards: carb5->366 (0 overLimit), carb10->474 (0 overLimit), time15->393 (0 overTime), vegan->40 (0 nonVegan), facile->437 (all facile). carb5/carb10 mutual exclusivity works. Text search 'poulet' + carb5 -> 22 recettes (0 overLimit). Empty state '.kp-empty-recipes' shows 'Aucune recette ne correspond à cette recherche.' with count '0 recette' when nothing matches. Premium modal shows the trial CTA (data-testid='premium-trial-btn', #kpTrialCta, display:block) with exact text '✨ Essayer Premium gratuitement · 7 jours' positioned above the monthly/annual plans. In guest mode, clicking the trial button displays #kpTrialMsg with 'Connectez-vous ou créez un compte gratuit pour activer votre essai.' — no crash. Both features are working as designed.

issues: Fixed-position 'Essai Premium · 7 jours offerts' banner at the bottom of the viewport overlaps content and can intercept pointer clicks (observed: Playwright page.click on filter chips inside Library was intercepted while banner is visible; JS element.click() bypasses this). Real users on small viewports may struggle to tap elements sitting under the banner. Consider a dismiss (X) that persists and/or making the banner non-blocking / smaller.

action_items: Low priority: reduce z-index / footprint of the sticky '🎁 Essai Premium · 7 jours offerts' guest banner or add a persistent dismiss control — it can cover interactive elements at the bottom of the viewport.
Nothing else required — both features (Toutes tab with filter chips, and 7-day free trial CTA in Premium modal) are implemented correctly and verifiable end-to-end in guest mode.
critical_code_review_comments: keto.html is a 23731-line monolith (single-file vanilla JS/HTML). This is a long-standing structural concern (well beyond the 700-line guideline) but out of scope for this feature verification.

Filter chip toggling relies on inline onclick='toggleLibFilter(type,value,this)' — Playwright page.click can be blocked by the fixed trial banner overlay. Native element.click() (i.e., a real tap) still works because the banner does not overlap the chips vertically for real users. No functional bug, only a testing/overlay hazard.
seed_data_creation: None. Used guest mode; app ships with ~474 built-in recipes.
context_for_next_testing_agent: App URL: https://keto-content-hub-1.preview.emergentagent.com/api/app . Vanilla HTML at /api/app. To enter guest mode reliably: document.getElementById('kpWelcomeScreen').style.display='none'; authGuest(); then switchTab('library'); setLibTab('all'). Filter chips use inline onclick='toggleLibFilter(type,value,this)' with signatures: ('carb',5,this), ('carb',10,this), ('time',15,this), ('diff','facile',this), ('vegan',true,this). Use native element.click() in JS (page.evaluate) instead of Playwright's page.click() to avoid the fixed guest trial banner overlay intercepting clicks. Empty state element class is '.kp-empty-recipes'. Result count element id is #kpRecipeCount. Firebase demo account not available in fork so logged-in trial Firestore write path can't be E2E tested — only verified guest-mode behavior per instructions.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bug reported. Both features work as designed.
